name: marque-testimonial
title: Marquee Testimonials
description: A light section headed Trusted by Industry Leaders, with two rows of white testimonial cards scrolling continuously in opposite directions. Each card carries five stars, a quote, and an author's initials, name, role and company.
use: A landing page wants continuous social proof without asking visitors to click or step through slides.
avoid: The motion never stops and there is no pause control, which distracts and fails reduced-motion users.
a11y: It scrolls forever with no pause or reduced-motion check, and the star ratings are icons with no text alternative. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-white section with a centred black heading and grey subtitle. Below run two rows of white rounded cards with soft shadows; each holds a faint quote mark, five yellow stars, a short grey paragraph, and a dark circular initials badge beside the name, role and company.
behaves: The top row slides steadily left and the bottom row slides right, each looping without pause while the side edges fade out. Hovering a card deepens its shadow. Nothing stops the scroll.
customise: Takes no props. The testimonial array, header copy, speeds, card width and colour palette are all set in the source, so new quotes mean editing the file.
weight: moderate: Twenty cards animate on an endless transform; cheap to paint but never idles.
demo: Five quotes from named engineers at Microsoft, Vercel and Google with initials avatars.
issues: The row never pauses, so a quote can scroll out mid-read.
Cards are clipped at the viewport edges as they enter.
polishWhy: Cards are clean and consistent; the endless scroll with clipped edges feels a little mechanical.
